issues.issue: Can the Minister appeal to the FCA from an order converting a judicial review into an action, given IRPA's no-appeal rules and no certified question?
issues.applicant_position: Minister says IRPA appeal limits apply only to judicial review; after conversion to an action, an unrestricted appeal lies under Federal Courts Act s.27.
issues.respondent_position: Respondents say the appeal is barred: no question was certified and IRPA Division 8 prevails over the Federal Courts Act.
issues.result_quote: We are all of the view that the respondents' motion should succeed.
